main_text.p: ὁ & λειτουργὸς[?] Dei. Similiter Exod. 22.28. & Psal.82.5.6. dicuntur Elo-him (Dii) & filii excelsi: quia sunt vicarii Dei. Item Psal.48.7v. Esa.49v. 23. nutritii ecclesiæ Christi, & Ezec. 34.23. vocantur patres.

Idem confirmat exempla sancto-rum veterum, Mosis, Davidis 1.Chr. 13.5. & 22. & seq. Solomonis 2.Chron. 2. & seq. Ezechiæ 2.Chron.29.5. Josiæ 2.Chron.34.33. & aliorum: qui omnia studio instituerunt ex Dei verbo pu-rum Dei cultum, & è medio sustule-runt quicquid veræ religioni obsta-culo[?]s es[?]se videretur, omnibusq; mo-dis, consiliis & facultatibus eccles-iam, & verbi divini ministerium pro-moverunt: eoque nomine compri-mis laudantur in scriptura. Contra-vero Jud. 21.25. inter vitia anarchias ponitur, quòd non esset rex in Isra-el, & quisq; faceret, quod placebat.
Huc etiam referri debent præcep-ta illa generalia, quæ ad totam ec-clesiam & singula ejus membra per-tinent. Matth.7.15. Cavete à pseu-doprophetis. Joh.3.39. & 7.17. vult

page.notes: Greek word in the first line (λειτουργὸς) is only partly legible; the accent and final letters are doubtful. Hyphenated line-end words are kept as printed. "obstaculos esse" in the middle paragraph is doubtful: the scan reads "culo es se". The Scripture reference "Psal.48.7v." and "Esa.49v." is partly obscured by the page fold. Marks in front of "Matth." and "Joh." look like printer's signs and are not copied. No marginal notes are printed on this page.
